title: An open immersion is an isomorphism onto the open subscheme on its image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-open-immersion], let $U=f(X)$, which is an open subset of $Y$, and let $j_U:U\to Y$ be the inclusion of the open subscheme $(U,\mathcal O_Y|_U)$ of $Y$. Then there is an isomorphism of schemes $\varphi:X\to U$ with $j_U\circ\varphi=f$; equivalently $f\circ\varphi^{-1}=j_U$.
